parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: **1 to 50**. Default value: **50**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

*   If this is your first request and no next requests are to be performed, you do not need to specify this parameter.
*   If a next request is to be performed, set the value to the value of **NextToken** that is returned from the last call.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the endpoint service that you want to query.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~120468~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: UserId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account in the whitelist of the endpoint service.

parameters.name: UserListType
parameters.description: The type of the user list in the whitelist of the endpoint service.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun privatelink list-vpc-endpoint-service-users --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --max-results 50 --service-id epsrv-hp3vpx8yqxblby3i0000 --user-id 12345678 --user-list-type Users --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun privatelink ListVpcEndpointServiceUsers --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --UserId 12345678 --MaxResults 50 --UserListType Users --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ServiceId 'epsrv-hp3vpx8yqxblby3i0000'
